source.data_source: CFL3D Spalart-Allmaras solution on TMR's 1409x641 grid (~901k cells), the finest in the verification suite.
source.cross_code_check: Both CFL3D and FUN3D published values; FUN3D matches CFL3D within ~3rd significant figure on Cf and ~5th on CD.

mesh_cell_count.description: Total cell count of the channel-and-bump mesh
mesh_cell_count.T_good_source: TMR coarsest grid is 89x41 (~3.6k cells); a wall-resolved RANS at Re=3e6 typically requires ~50k cells in 2D. Hand-set.

final_residual_U.description: Final residual of the momentum equation
final_residual_U.T_good_source: Hand-set; subsonic RANS routinely reaches 1e-5 on this geometry.

cd_total.description: Total drag coefficient (pressure + viscous) integrated over the lower wall, normalised by 0.5 rho_inf U_inf^2 L_ref
cd_total.T_good_source: CFL3D-SA on 1409x641 grid: CD=3.572e-3 (= 35.7 drag-counts). T_good=3 dc / ~8% allows for turbulence-model variation between SA, SST, etc.

cd_pressure.T_good_source: CFL3D-SA on 1409x641 grid: C_Dp=3.82e-4 (~11% of total). T_good wider relative to magnitude because pressure-drag separation is sensitive to bump pressure-gradient capture.

cd_viscous.T_good_source: CFL3D-SA on 1409x641 grid: C_Dv=3.191e-3 (~89% of total). T_good ~8% of gt allows turbulence-model + grid-resolution scatter.

cf_at_x_063.description: Local skin-friction coefficient C_f at x=0.63 m (mid-acceleration on bump)
cf_at_x_063.T_good_source: CFL3D-SA on 1409x641 grid: C_f63=5.185e-3. T_good ~10% of gt.

cf_at_x_075.description: Local C_f at x=0.75 m (apex of bump, peak shear)
cf_at_x_075.T_good_source: CFL3D-SA on 1409x641 grid: C_f75=6.149e-3 (peak). T_good ~10% of gt.

cf_at_x_087.description: Local C_f at x=0.87 m (deceleration region downstream of apex)
cf_at_x_087.T_good_source: CFL3D-SA on 1409x641 grid: C_f87=2.678e-3. Adverse-pressure-gradient region; sensitive to turbulence-model anisotropy. T_good ~11% of gt.
